title: Quantum filtering and propagation of chaos for open quantum systems, with applications to quantum feedback control and quantum mean-field games
summary: The theory of quantum filtering (of quantum continuous measurements) was developed by V.P. Belavkin about 40 years ago. Since then it attracted attention of numerous investigators including mathematicians, theoretical and experimental physicists. However, the rigorous mathematical theory of the filtering equations for mixed states in basic infinite-dimensional quantum systems remained an open problem, which was resolved by the author recently.
